project_type: Monorepo: Cloudflare Workers (edge), FastAPI Python (backend), React/Vite (frontend)
build_system: pnpm monorepo with workspaces (pnpm@10.26.1, Node 22), pip for Python backend
verification_instructions: Validate YAML syntax of all workflow files with actionlint or yamllint, ensure no syntax errors in shell scripts with shellcheck, verify all workflow files reference correct paths
setup_instructions: pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile at root, pip install -r apps/backend/requirements.txt for Python
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. No Docker daemon in sandbox for actual runs, but can validate workflow YAML syntax.
contribution_requirements: Pin action versions (use @v4 or specific SHA), use least-privilege permissions blocks, include concurrency groups, use workflow_dispatch for manual triggering
key_patterns: Existing workflows use: actions/checkout@v6, actions/setup-node@v6, actions/setup-python@v6, corepack enable + pnpm@10.26.1, ubuntu-latest runners, concurrency groups like deploy-${{ github.ref }}, permissions blocks, sed hack to strip hashes from requirements.txt
directory_structure: apps/backend (FastAPI Python), apps/edge (Cloudflare Worker TS), apps/frontend (React Vite), .github/workflows (CI/CD), .github/scripts (helper scripts), scripts/ (operational scripts), infra/ (Azure Bicep + deployment scripts)
